suggestions.rationale: PTSD can aggravate or proximately cause Obstructive Sleep Apnea, often mediated through weight gain from psychotropic medications or chronic sleep disturbances.
evidenceGaps: Medical nexus opinion linking OSA to PTSD or PTSD medications

sourceReferences.note: Secondary service connection via intermediate step (weight gain)

suggestions.rationale: Chronic stress, tension, and sleep deprivation associated with PTSD can trigger or aggravate chronic migraine headaches.
evidenceGaps: Neurological or medical nexus linking migraines to PTSD symptoms

suggestions.rationale: Medications commonly prescribed for PTSD (like SSRIs) frequently cause sexual dysfunction, including ED, as a side effect.
evidenceGaps: Urology or primary care diagnosis of ED

sourceReferences.note: Secondary to service-connected medication side effects
